updates.problem: The pull_request workflow advertised the PR head SHA in run metadata but default checkout executed the synthetic merge ref, allowing merge-integration evidence to be mislabeled as exact-candidate evidence.
updates.target: Explicitly select and assert the candidate head SHA for pull_request runs and github.sha for push runs before installing or testing candidate code.
updates.falsifier: If an independently observed GitHub primitive proves executed source identity without explicit checkout/ref assertion, compare it against the explicit binding and retain the simpler equally strong mechanism.

updates.new_evidence: The ref-state classifier caught the earlier Round-026 false promotion class, but Round-027 adversarial review exposed a separate executed-test-subject identity coordinate.
Pinned action refs are active and passed exact-main push tests, but the original Round-027 pre-promotion PR test was a merge-ref execution and cannot be called exact-head.

saturation.reason: A second adversarial pass found a new exact-subject identity residual during the same closure run.
